description: Not everything is about us, no need to internalize others behaviors 🥂 #nervoussystemhealing #DesignYourLife #LifeByDesign
transcript: I do not internalize others' behaviors, because not everything is about me, and although I live in my own world, so do others. And it is not my responsibility to take others' problems, to take others' things and make them mine. Not everything is about us, and sometimes we allow our egos to take offense to any and everything. Guess there are circumstances where we can be offended, and we can take things personal, but two things can exist at the same time. It is not always about us.
